data.content: # Belarus vs Finland Prediction: The group leader will take their chance on neutral ground. ## Belarus vs Finland: Prediction for the match on 6 October 2026. The goalless draw in Finland was beneficial in terms of points but lacked excitement, and Belarus started with a 0-2 defeat to Albania.
